_why_not_self_generated: The outcome is linear in the predictors by construction, so the coefficients the generator uses ARE the parameters ordinary least squares estimates. The error variance differs by arm, which does not bias those coefficients and does make the classical standard error wrong -- so an implementation that reports the classical SE recovers the truth and still reports the wrong interval. That is why the standard errors are compared as well as the estimates.

agreement.claim: both engines report the same coefficients and the same HC3, HC0, HC1 and classical standard errors on identical rows
agreement._what_this_does_and_does_not_catch: IT CATCHES THE CLASSICAL-VERSUS-ROBUST MISTAKE WITH ROOM TO SPARE AND BARELY SEPARATES THE ROBUST FLAVOURS. Measured on this fixture with an independent stdlib least-squares fit: the classical exposure SE is 0.070450 against HC3's 0.076798, a gap of 6.35e-3 or sixty times the tolerance. HC0 sits 1.97e-4 from HC3 and HC1 1.01e-4, which is one to two times the tolerance -- detectable, but with no margin worth relying on. So the flavour is NOT guarded by this check. It is guarded by must_appear below, which is enforced against the code of all four files including the two nothing executes.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the coefficients the fixture used
recovery._calibration: MEASURED, not guessed. Three hundred alternative seeds of this exact generator were fitted with a stdlib least-squares implementation: the worst of the three misses had a median of 0.0585, a 95th percentile of 0.1436 and a maximum of 0.2650, and 0.3% of seeds exceeded 0.25. The committed seed's worst miss is 0.0283, about a ninth of the tolerance. Earlier entries in this library set this figure provisionally and were wrong twice (0.15 against 0.13 observed, 0.04 against 0.097), which is what this calibration exists to avoid.

_stdlib_crosscheck._what_this_is: A THIRD implementation, written in the standard library alone to calibrate the tolerance above, recorded here because a disagreement between it and the two executed engines would be worth knowing about. IT IS NOT THE TRUTH AND NOTHING IS CHECKED AGAINST IT -- recovery is judged against `truth`, which comes from the generator and not from running anything. A golden regenerated by the build it is meant to check pins nothing, and this file must not become one.
